hardwareHubs.note: Home to Protohaven, the ARM Institute and Catalyst Connection.
NextFab operates a large membership makerspace in North Philadelphia.

makerspaces.name: Protohaven
makerspaces.note: Lists a CNC plasma cutter, CNC wood router, laser cutting, 3D printing and an electronics bench.

makerspaces.name: NextFab
makerspaces.note: Lists 3D printing, laser cutting, electronics, metalworking and woodworking departments.

programs.name: ARM Institute
programs.note: Manufacturing USA institute funding robotics and AI projects for manufacturing, with a 500 plus member consortium.

programs.name: Ben Franklin Technology Partners
programs.note: Offers early-stage investment, business and technical guidance and mentor introductions through four regional partners.

specialties.name: Robotics and manufacturing automation
specialties.note: The ARM Institute is based at Mill 19 in Pittsburgh and aims to speed robotics adoption in manufacturing.

support.name: Catalyst Connection
support.note: Pittsburgh nonprofit and part of the Pennsylvania MEP, serving small manufacturers in 12 counties of southwestern Pennsylvania.

support.name: Pennsylvania MEP network
support.note: NIST lists Catalyst Connection, NWIRC, NEPIRC and IMC as centers serving the state.
